sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’
  2. Search for Template Sell Demo Importer
  3. Activate Template Sell Demo Importer plugin from your Plugins page.
  4. Go to the Appearance -> Import Demo Data
    Note: Make sure, One click demo import plugin is installed and activated first.

From WordPress.org

  1. Download templatesell-demo-importer.
  2. Upload the ‘templatesell-demo-importer’ directory to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory, using your favorite method (ftp, sftp, scp, etc…)
  3. Activate Template Sell Demo Importer from your Plugins page.
    Note: Make sure, One click demo import plugin is installed and activated first.
sections.faq:
1. Where I can see the Settings?
    Check all the available options inside Appearance > Import Demo Data
sections.changelog:
= 1.0.5 – August 21 2026=
* Prefer: all twelve demos from the demo page are declared, and each one appears as soon as its files are in the plugin
* Prefer: demos that differ only in arrangement share one content file, so the download does not grow for each of them
* Prefer: a demo can be served from the shop’s own server instead of shipping inside the plugin
* Prefer: fixed a fatal error during the after import step, which used a menu variable it never set
* Prefer: the Masonry demo linked to the wrong preview site
* Removed a leftover copy of the Polite News content file that was shipping with the plugin
= 1.0.4 – August 19 2026=
* Polite News: five demos (Main, Classic Newspaper, Magazine Masonry, Minimal Reader, Bold Sports) sharing one content file
* Demo grid: demo name and buttons now sit side by side and stay visible, on rounded cards
* Polite News: About, Advertise, Contact, Terms and Privacy Policy pages are created after the import and the menu items that pointed at # are aimed at them, so an imported demo has no dead links
* Polite News: the site tagline is filled in when the site has none, so the front page has a document title and a description worth showing

= 1.0.3 – August 18 2026=
* Added demo content for Polite News theme
* Compatibility checked with the latest WordPress

= 1.0.2 – March 21 2022=
* Added demo content for Rector theme

= 1.0.1 – December 11 2020=
* Added demo content for Docile theme

= 1.0.0 – October 18 2020=
* Submitted on .org
